_comment: DAC+ HAT stacked on a Raspberry Pi 5 with the standard 11 mm M2.5 standoffs and a 2x20 female socket. Coordinates are Pi 5 board mm (z up from the Pi PCB bottom). The HAT's hole pattern (58 x 49, origin at its corner) lines up with the Pi's, so it only moves up: Pi top 1.6 + 11 = 12.6.

expected._comment: x: Pi -1 .. 88.6; y: HAT RCA barrels at -9 .. HAT edge 56.5; z: HAT top 12.6 + 13.6
